question: The approximate total length of the coastline of the mainland of India, Lakshadweep Islands and Andaman & Nicobar Islands is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**11098.81 **__km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lakshadweep is the smallest union territory in India.

 
 
• The word meaning of Lakshadweep is 'one hundred thousand islands'.
 
• It is located in the Arabian sea.
 
• The old name of Lakshadweep was Laccadive.
 
• Formed on 1st November 1956.
 
• Adopted the name Lakshadweep on 1st November 1973.
 
• Capital: Kavaratti.
 
• Former capital: Kozhikode.
 
• Official Languages: Malayalam, English
 
• The union territory comes under the jurisdiction of the Kerala High Court at Kochi.
 
• Maldives is the country nearest to Lakshadweep.
 
• Agatti Airport is the only airport located in Lakshadweep.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a group of 572__ islands/islets located at the juncture of the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea.
 
• Murga Island, Aves Island and Baratang Island are some of the important islands of Andaman Group of Islands.
